title: 第十五章 踏雪无痕第十六章 人形猛兽
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 李水生在客栈里最好的客房住下，眺望远处的天山白雪。
“这么孤零零一座大山，不像是自然生成啊。”
合上窗，李水生摊开偷天魔功。
如今在天山落脚，总算是安生下来，有时间慢慢参悟偷天魔功了。
修炼偷天魔功，会将内气转化为偷天魔功的内气。
但李水生并不担心自己无法施展太素银针。
一门内功修行到圆满之后，便可以通过调整内气运行路线，再次施展出来。
即便是偷天魔功的内气，他也能短暂转化为太素心经内气。
灵丹炼制成功之日，整个江湖，乃至朝廷，将会有一场狂欢盛宴。
而李水生，想要去看戏。
如果看戏的时候能顺便搞到一本修仙功法，那就更好了。
天下群雄，给点力啊。
最好是能将国师磨死！
而现在，他需要努力达到看戏的实力。
其他内功，都是将内气储存在经脉中，但偷天魔功完全不同。
它是将内气用来滋养血肉，淬炼体魄！
练了不过三日，李水生便明显感觉到自己的力道增长了几分。
“如此厉害，不愧是偷天魔功！”
“如今我练功一日，好似练功十日！”
“便是不借助药浴，我也能在十年之内再涨百年功力，成为一流高手！”
“若是借助药浴......”
“不愧是最适合我的内功！”
再看面板，依旧是无尽寿元！
在无尽寿元面前，偷天魔功消耗的寿元根本没有任何意义。
顾青泉再次来访。
“我与诸位师兄商议过了，如此多的银子，我天山一时片刻确实拿不出来。”
“大师兄开出了一个方案。”
李水生抬手，“请讲。”
顾青泉道：“若是李神医愿意在我天山坐馆十年，我天山可拿出两门主峰绝学供李神医挑选。”
“而且李神医每年还有一颗天山雪莲子，以补偿李神医消耗的功力。”
“如此，李神医可否只收四成银子？”
李水生盘算一番，在天山坐馆十年倒是问题不大，他本就准备在此处默默发育十年。
改稻为药的那一场盛宴，还有十五年呢。
“四成银子，不够我购买药材。”
“六成吧，我平常也需要花销。”
content_en:
Li Shuisheng stayed in the best guest room in the inn and looked at the snowy Tianshan Mountains in the distance.
"Such a lonely mountain doesn't look like it was created naturally."
After closing the window, Li Shuisheng spread out his Heaven-Stealing Demonic Skill.
Now that I have settled down in Tianshan, I have finally settled down and have time to slowly comprehend the Heaven Stealing Demonic Skill.
Practicing the Heaven-Stealing Demonic Art will transform the inner energy into the inner energy of the Heaven-Stealing Demonic Art.
But Li Shuisheng was not worried that he would not be able to use Taisu Silver Needle.
After an internal skill has been practiced to perfection, it can be displayed again by adjusting the route of internal energy.
Even the inner Qi of the Heaven-Stealing Demonic Art can be transformed into the inner Qi of Tai Su Heart Meridian for a short period of time.
On the day when the elixir is successfully refined, there will be a carnival feast throughout the world, and even the court.
And Li Shuisheng wanted to go to the theater.
It would be even better if you could pick up a copy of the Immortal Cultivation Technique while watching the show.
All heroes in the world, give me some strength.
It would be best to grind the national master to death!
But now, he needs to work hard to reach the level of watching theater.
Other internal skills store internal energy in the meridians, but the Heaven-stealing Demon Skill is completely different.
It uses inner energy to nourish flesh and blood and temper the body!
After practicing for only three days, Li Shuisheng clearly felt that his strength had increased a bit.
"It's so powerful, it's worthy of the Heaven-Stealing Demonic Skill!"
"Now when I practice Qigong for one day, it feels like I practiced Qigong for ten days!"
"Even without the help of medicinal baths, I can increase my skill by another hundred years in ten years and become a first-rate master!"
"If you use medicinal bath..."
"Hiss!"
"It is indeed the most suitable internal strength for me!"
Looking at the panel again, it’s still endless longevity!
In the face of endless lifespan, the lifespan consumed by the Heaven Stealing Demonic Skill has no meaning at all.
Gu Qingquan visited again.
"I have discussed it with all the senior brothers. I, Tianshan, really cannot afford such a large amount of silver in a short while."
"Elder brother has come up with a plan."
Li Shuisheng raised his hand, "Please speak."
Gu Qingquan said: "If Divine Doctor Li is willing to stay in our Tianshan Mountains for ten years, our Tianshan Mountains can provide Divine Doctor Li with two unique skills from the main peak."
"And Divine Doctor Li also has a Tianshan Snow Lotus Seed every year to compensate for the skill that Divine Doctor Li consumes."
"In this case, can Divine Doctor Li only accept 40% of the silver?"
Li Shuisheng made some calculations and found that it would not be a big problem to sit in Tianshan for ten years. He had planned to develop silently here for ten years.
The feast of converting rice into medicine is still fifteen years away.
"Forty percent of the silver is not enough for me to buy medicinal materials."
"Sixty percent, I usually need to spend money."
